sentence_quote: The appellant will be sentenced to a term of fifteen months imprisonment to be served in the community on the conditions to be set out in the draft order.
note: Eight months jail replaced by 15-month conditional sentence with curfew and community service; probation continues; 14 days served.

offence_note: Sexual assault, extortion, breach of trust by public official
sentence_quote: It is the sentence of this court that you serve a total term of imprisonment of six years.
note: 3 years each on three counts; sexual assault consecutive to breach of trust, extortion concurrent. SOIRA 20 years.

offence_note: Possession of cannabis resin for purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: I sentence you to a sentence of nine months incarceration, to be served consecutively to any other sentence.
note: Joint recommendation; victim surcharge waived; s. 109 order for life.

offence_note: Dangerous operation of a motor vehicle
sentence_quote: leave to appeal sentence is granted, the appeal from sentence is allowed and the sentence imposed at trial is reduced by a further 300 days.
note: Total sentence length not stated; reduced by further 300 days for pre-disposition custody credit at 1.5:1.

offence_note: Two counts criminal negligence causing death (impaired-type crash)
sentence_quote: it would be my judgment that a fit sentence is five and one-half years. I am going to give you credit for one year of the time you have served, one year of the 14 months.
note: Concurrent 4.5 years on each count after credit; 14 months pre-sentence custody.

offence_note: Second degree murder with sexual assault
sentence_quote: Pursuant to s. 235(1) of the Criminal Code, I sentence you to the mandatory sentence of life imprisonment. Pursuant to s. 745.4 of the Criminal Code, I order that your sentence of life imprisonment be served with no eligibility for parole for 23 years.

offence_note: Two counts aggravated assault by wounding and maiming
sentence_quote: the fit and proper sentence in this case is one of thirty-six months for the aggravated assault on Mr. MacDonald and twenty-four months for the assault on Ms. Ryan, to run concurrently.
note: Court recommends mental health and substance abuse programming in prison; not an alternative institution.

offence_note: Contempt of court for refusing to testify at murder trial
sentence_quote: The appellant was found guilty of contempt of court and sentenced to three years, consecutive to his 12-year sentence for manslaughter.
note: Three years consecutive to earlier 12-year manslaughter sentence; youth and prospects considered but denunciation primary.

offence_note: Second degree murder, killing for hire
sentence_quote: I will accede to the joint submission and sentence Mr. Lopez to life imprisonment with a period of parole ineligibility of 20 years.
note: Only Lopez sentenced in this decision; co-accused Fox sentenced separately; victim surcharge waived.

offence_note: Trafficking-purpose possession of three drugs, prohibited device, proceeds of crime
sentence_quote: The sentence imposed – a penitentiary term of five years (less credit for pre-disposition custody) – falls within the range of sentence appropriate in cases such as this.
note: 3.5 years after 18 months credit; ancillary orders not shown.
